title: diplopappus scaber
intro: Diplopappus scaber, commonly known as the woolly diplopappus, is a plant species in the family Asteraceae. This plant is used in traditional medicine to provide various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to soothe digestive issues, reduce fever, and protect against infections. The therapeutic actions of Diplopappus scaber include its ability to modulate the immune system and exhibit antiviral activity, making it a potential natural remedy for various diseases. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
